facts.fact: ARTICLE 19 and AFIC state that Senegal's National Assembly adopted loi n°2025-15 relative à l'accès à l'information on 25 August 2025 and the President enacted it; it guarantees a right to ask public bodies for information and sets an independent oversight mechanism.
